reasoning: As of March 2026, Russia has been pushing for RIC revival, but India-China border tensions and India's multi-alignment strategy create significant obstacles to a dedicated trilateral leaders' meeting. While three-way huddles occur on margins of larger forums (SCO, etc.), a formal scheduled trilateral meeting at heads-of-state/government or foreign minister level is a higher bar. The 6-month window (March-September 2026) is relatively short. Recent geopolitical friction between India and China, combined with India's strategic balancing act, makes a dedicated trilateral unlikely despite Russian efforts. Informal meetings on sidelines are more probable than formal trilateral meetings.
